links.description_fil: Opisyal na website ng pamahalaang lungsod: balita, serbisyo, at mga dokumento.
links.description_en: Official website of the city government: news, services, and documents.

links.description_fil: Listahan ng mga ordinansang ipinasa ng Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Pasig.
links.description_en: List of ordinances passed by the Pasig City Council (Sangguniang Panlungsod).

links.description_fil: Listahan ng mga planong bilhin at ipagawa ng lungsod sa 2026. May tinatayang badyet para sa bawat proyekto.
links.description_en: Plan of everything the city will buy and build in 2026, with estimated budget per project.
links.note: Procurement reports are hosted under assets.pasigcity.gov.ph/storage/procurement_reports/. The landing page for BAC postings was not found.

links.description_fil: Humiling ng dokumento ng Pasig sa pambansang eFOI portal. Mahigit 1,160 kahilingan na ang nakalista.
links.description_en: Request documents from Pasig online through the national eFOI portal. More than 1,160 requests are listed.

links.title_fil: Pasig Transparency Mechanism Ordinance (Ord. Blg. 37, s. 2018)
links.title_en: Pasig Transparency Mechanism Ordinance (Ordinance No. 37, s. 2018)
links.description_fil: Sa ilalim ng lokal na ordinansa sa FOI, puwedeng humingi ng pampublikong rekord ang sinuman kahit walang ibigay na dahilan. Kailangang asikasuhin ang kahilingan sa loob ng 10 araw. May parusa sa hindi susunod.
links.description_en: Local FOI ordinance: anyone may request a public record without giving a reason; it must be acted on within 10 days; there are penalties for those who do not comply.

links.title_en: Ugnayan sa Pasig (FOI and feedback office)
links.description_fil: Tanggapan para sa mga kahilingan sa FOI, tanong at reklamo. Inilunsad ito noong Hulyo 15, 2019. Makipag-ugnayan sa social media, sa cellphone o nang personal.
links.description_en: Office for FOI requests, questions, and complaints. Launched July 15, 2019. You can file through social media, mobile, or in person.
links.note: No dedicated official URL found; link is a news source.

links.title_fil: EO Blg. PCG-16, s. 2022 (CSO Desk at People's Council)
links.title_en: Executive Order No. PCG-16, s. 2022 (CSO Desk / People's Council)
links.description_fil: Itinatag ang CSO Desk (Abril 18, 2022) para buuin ang Pasig People's Council ng mga accredited na CSO at PO at para makilahok sila sa pagpaplano, pagbabadyet at pagsubaybay.
links.description_en: Established the CSO Desk (April 18, 2022) to form the Pasig People's Council of accredited CSOs and POs and for their participation in planning, budgeting, and monitoring.

links.description_fil: Pambansang portal kung saan inilalathala ng mga LGU ang mga dokumento tungkol sa badyet, pananalapi at bidding (Full Disclosure Policy).
links.description_en: National portal where LGUs publish their budget, finances, and bidding documents (Full Disclosure Policy).
links.note: Pasig-specific FDP page URL not found.

links.description_en: COA's annual audit of Pasig's finances (search 'City of Pasig' in the NCR LGU reports).
